paper.title: DNA Chisel, a versatile sequence optimizer

generators.name: stochastic mutation generator
generators.description: Propose DNA candidates via random mutations during local region optimization.

evidence.quote: A region's sequence is optimized via either a stochastic search (using random mutations of the sequence) or an exhaustive search through all possible sequence variants, depending on the number of variants.

constraints.name: windowed GC content
constraints.description: Keep GC content between 45 and 65 percent on every 100-nucleotide window.

evidence.quote: Gene NUM1 of Saccharomyces cerevisiae will be codon optimized for Escherischia coli, and have a GC content of 40-60% on every 100-nucleotide window.
EnforceGCContent ... @gc(45-65%/100bp) Ensures that the GC content of the final sequence is ... within given bounds ... on a sliding window decided by the user.

constraints.name: BsaI site removal
constraints.description: Remove BsaI restriction sites that impede DNA synthesis and assembly.

evidence.quote: BsaI restriction sites will be removed (@no(BsaI_site) constraint).

constraints.name: homopolymer limit
constraints.description: Reject homopolymer runs that impede synthesis.

evidence.quote: Removal of regulatory elements or elements impeding DNA synthesis and assembly.

optimizers.name: MCMC refinement
optimizers.description: Iteratively refine candidates after hard constraints are resolved; stands in for DNA Chisel's two-step local solver.

evidence.quote: The optimization algorithm ... has two main steps: (1) resolution of all hard constraints, ignoring optimization objectives, and (2) objectives maximization with respect to the constraints.

model_dependencies.name: Biopython
model_dependencies.purpose: Genbank operations and restriction enzyme data in DNA Chisel

evidence.quote: DNA Chisel is implemented in Python. It relies on the Biopython library (Cock et al., 2009) for Genbank operations and restriction enzyme data.

steps.operation: resolve hard constraints on unsatisfactory regions

evidence.quote: During each step, unsatisfactory sequence regions are detected and separately optimized.

steps.operation: score windowed GC and pattern constraints
maximize weighted objectives under satisfied constraints

evidence.quote: This steps separation allows to detect incompatible constraints early, and quickly reach satisfactory solutions.

assumptions: MCMC refinement approximates DNA Chisel's region-local stochastic search after hard constraints are resolved.
BsaI site removal is approximated via homopolymer and pattern filtering in the Proto baseline binding.
Windowed GC is evaluated with global gc_content_constraint parameters as a v1 simplification.
unknowns: CodonOptimize and EnforceTranslation objectives are deferred to a later pipeline version.
Exact DNA Chisel local solver heuristics and custom specification resolution methods are not reproduced.
AvoidMatches homology removal against reference genomes is not bound in v1.
